label: µPython (Wasm)
notes: An instance is one loadMicroPython() call (default heap) that runs first_response = 1 + 1 and reads it back through globals.
Memory: resident growth of the Node host across 20 live instances, after three forced GCs before and after.
Start: median of the last 20 of 22 loads.

Tool call: Python awaits an async host function. MicroPython's JavaScript bridge keeps per-realm state, so only the newest instance in a realm can make host calls; the newest of the 20 is measured. Median of per-batch means, 20,000 calls in batches of 500 after 2,000 warm-ups; 70.07 µs of CPU per call.
Compute: one instance with its heap raised to 256 MiB, because the default cannot hold the parsed dataset; json is MicroPython's built-in C module and the interpreter has no JIT.
